NITI Aayog Sets $81 Billion Chemical Export Target for 2030 Amid Challenges

NITI Aayog has set a target of $81 billion for India's chemical sector exports by 2030. While outlining this goal, the Aayog also acknowledged that challenges exist in achieving it. The Economic Times reported that the chemicals industry sees an export runway to reach this $81 billion mark by the target year. The Financial Express noted the specific target and the presence of challenges.
